assessment.method: The runtime's verifier at its shipped commit (ori/skills/signing.py, canonical_signed_payload) was read against the signed-bytes rule of this version at 82b5129.
divergences: The runtime verifies an Ed25519 signature over the canonical JSON of the parsed skill.yaml mapping with `signature` removed (keys sorted, compact separators), not over the exact artifact bytes this version requires; it has never implemented the exact-bytes rule.

adoption.notes: The README states the Hub signs under both profiles of this contract.
Signing and verification helpers exist; the SDK does not cite this contract.
